API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APILocation ManagementUpdate Location Template
Update Location Template
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/locationTemplate/:templateId

Updates the location template specified by the location template ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
templateId
int32
REQUIRED

ID of the location template.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
id
int32

ID of Cloud & Branch Connector location template.

name
string

Name of Cloud & Branch Connector location template.

desc
string

Description of Cloud & Branch Connector location template.

template
object
editable
boolean

Whether Cloud & Branch Connector location template is editable.

lastModUid
object
lastModTime
int32

Last time Cloud & Branch Connector location template was modified.

Responses
​
default

Default Response. See API Response Codes

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
